messages.author: d1e9d30595320d5e
messages.subject: d3Network output
parts:
I've been trying to integrate plots created by d3Network with Shiny. I'm pretty close but am missing two key things. 

I have an example here: https://github.com/christophergandrud/d3ShinyExample

The example creates the network graph just fine and it is responsive to (slider) input. However,

  1. The plots are not returned in the fluid layout container, but at the bottom of the page.

  2. Each time a new input is entered a new plot is outputted in addition to the previous plots.

 Any thoughts on how to solve these two issues?

messages.author: a58a2a3609db3342
messages.subject: Re: d3Network output
parts:
1). and 2) likely have the same fix. In your R code I note
var svg = d3.select(\"body\").append(\"svg\")

If this was changed to

var svg = d3.select(\"#someId\").append(\"svg\")

It would probably fix the issue
